facts.business: Bansal Wire Industries Limited is India's largest stainless steel wire manufacturer and second largest steel wire manufacturer by volume, producing diverse wire products for automotive, infrastructure, farming, fencing, poultry, and other sectors across domestic and global markets.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: India's largest single-location steel wire manufacturing facility

guidance_or_targets.statement: Strengthen leadership, enhance profitability and create enduring stakeholder value
Growing with stronger execution, better capital discipline and sharper product mix

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Recognition of Supplier Discounts involving significant judgment regarding timing of recognition and measurement, particularly for discounts contingent on achieving purchase volume thresholds

key_risks: Supplier discount recognition involving significant judgment and risk of premature/incorrect recognition
Forward-looking statements may not be realized
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include sales to Balaji Wires Private Limited (Rs 417.60M in FY26, Rs 656.03M in FY25), purchases from Balaji Wires Private Limited (Rs 37.80M in FY26, Rs 754.61M in FY25), and other transactions with 17 listed related entities including wholly owned subsidiaries Bansal Steel & Power Limited and BWI Steel Private Limited.
